description: Meme based on a classical-style painting of American Revolutionary War soldiers in Continental Army uniforms with muskets and bayonets, in which every soldier's face has been replaced with the face of Pepe the Frog. Overlaid across the lower portion in calligraphic script mimicking the U.S. Constitution's preamble is the text 'We the Pepe'. The image merges Revolutionary War imagery with the Pepe meme commonly used in Q/4chan communities.
flags: Pepe the Frog imagery is associated with 4chan/Q communities and has been designated a hate symbol in some contexts, though used here in a patriotic-meme register

description: Vintage snapshot, apparently 1980s from the clothing and film quality, of an adult white man with curly hair wearing denim overalls over a white T-shirt sitting outdoors on a low concrete planter ledge with his arm around a young Black boy in a cream button-up shirt who holds a small stuffed dog toy. The setting looks like an outdoor shopping mall or plaza with poinsettia plants, pedestrians, and storefronts behind them. No caption or text identifies the individuals in the image itself.
flags: Individuals not identifiable from the image alone; the child is a minor and is left unnamed per policy
This photo circulated in Q-adjacent contexts with identification claims not verifiable from the image itself

description: Screenshot of an 8chan Q drop dated March 14, 2019 (No. 5681798, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI), rendered in the standard green Q-post style. The drop claims Rep. Adam Schiff, as a member of the congressional 'Gang of Eight', knowingly spread false information and asks what 'insurance' was held over POTUS, closing with 'A FATHER'S LOVE FOR HIS CHILDREN KNOWS NO BOUNDS.' All statements are the drop's claims.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 03/14/19 (Thu) 13:12:08 ID: b35117 (4) No.5681798 >>5681804. REMEMBER THIS IMPORTANT FACT. ADAM SCHIFF IS PART OF THE 'GANG OF EIGHT' (INTEL). IT WILL BECOME CRITICAL ONCE 'GANG OF EIGHT' MATERIAL IS DECLASSIFIED. LOGICAL Q: IF ADAM SCHIFF 'KNEW' EVERYTHING HE'S INVESTIGATING AND STATING PUBLICLY TO BE KNOWINGLY 'FALSE' [DISINFORMATION] WHY THEN WOULD HE TAKE THE COURSE OF ACTION(S) (ONGOING)? DID ADAM SCHIFF PURPOSELY DECEIVE THE AMERICAN PUBLIC 'THINKING' THE 'GANG OF EIGHT' MATERIAL + OTHER CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTATION WOULD NEVER REACH THE PUBLIC DOMAIN? WHAT 'INSURANCE' DID THEY HANG OVER POTUS' HEAD IN ORDER TO PREVENT ACTION? A FATHER'S LOVE FOR HIS CHILDREN KNOWS NO BOUNDS. Q
flags: The drop's assertions about Adam Schiff and 'insurance' over POTUS are unverified claims made by the Q post

description: Photograph of a United States flag on a dark flagpole, backlit by the sun and waving against a blue sky with thin haze. The sunlight shines through the fabric from behind, illuminating the stars and stripes. This stock-style flag image was commonly appended to Q drops as patriotic imagery.

Screenshot of a verified WikiLeaks tweet from March 21, 2019 claiming that a rarely seen U.S. Department of Justice jet with tail number N996GA flew to London on Tuesday and had not been recorded as leaving. The tweet includes a FlightAware tracking map showing a green flight path arcing across the North Atlantic from the U.S. East Coast to London. The DOJ association and significance of the flight are the tweet's claims.
text: WikiLeaks @wikileaks. Following. A rarely seen US Department of Justice jet "N996GA" flew to London on Tuesday and has not been recorded as leaving. flightaware.com/live/flight/N9... 2:05 PM - 21 Mar 2019
flags: The claim that N996GA is a DOJ jet and the implication of its London stay are WikiLeaks' assertions, not verified in the image
